**Reuse directive for engineer**: `unique_labels` must import and delegate to `normalization.normalize_label` — do not reimplement casefold/hyphen logic inline in `label_index.py`.

**Behavior contract (verified empirically)**:
| Aspect | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Unicode | `str.casefold()`, not `.lower()`: `Straße`→`strasse`, `İstanbul`→`i̇stanbul` (i + U+0307). Duplicates must be detected on casefolded form, so `Straße` and `STRASSE` collapse to one entry. |
| Ordering | First-seen order of the input list (not sorted). Use `dict.fromkeys` or an ordered scan — `set` iteration is not acceptable. |
| Duplicates | Dedupe *after* normalization: `['Foo', 'foo', 'FOO']` → `['foo']`. |
| Empties | Normalize first, then drop empty results: whitespace-only inputs (`'  '`) normalize to `''` and must be excluded. |
| Input preservation | Do not mutate `values`; return a new list. (Strings are immutable; the list must not be sorted or filtered in place.) |
| Whitespace | All whitespace runs (spaces, tabs, newlines) collapse to single hyphens; leading/trailing whitespace trimmed: `'Foo  Bar '`→`'foo-bar'`. |

**Style match**: both files use bare one-line docstrings, full type hints, no imports currently — the import of `normalize_label` will be `label_index.py`'s first import. Keep it minimal.
